title: A source card: one publisher this project reads
description: Deliberately small. The Canadian atlas's copy grew to 51 properties, one per thing some card happened to need, and additionalProperties:false then made it the real definition of a source. This one grows a property at a time, as each Turkish source card is written, so the schema always describes sources that exist.

page.description: The source's own page, where its terms and tables are published.

bulletin.description: A TÜİK press bulletin and the tables published with it.

tables.description: Each table's download token. TÜİK's portal builds a download URL as /api/tr/data/downloads?t=t&pid=<id>&p=<token>; the token is an opaque but STABLE identifier for the table (checked across page loads 2026-09-20), while the ts= the page also sends is only a cache-buster.

label.description: The link text TÜİK gives the table, verbatim.
